pp.P_Competent_Department AS P_Competent_Department, pp.P_Department AS P_Department, pp.P_Inv_Total AS P_Inv_Total, sp.Set_Time_Schedule AS Set_Time_Schedule, sp.Start_Time_Schedule AS COALESCE(task_section.Set_Time, task_global.Set_Time) AS Set_Time, COALESCE(task_section.Start_Time, task_global.Start_Time) AS Start_Time, COALESCE(task_section.Finish_Time, task_global.Finish_Time) Complete_Records_Time, COALESCE(task_section.P_Remove_Time, task_global.P_Remove_Time) AS P_Remove_Time, COALESCE(task_section.Account_Submit_Time, task_global.Account_Submit_Time) AS Account_Submit_Time, COALESCE(task_section.Account_Reply_Time, task_global.Account_Reply_Time) AS Account_Reply_Time, COALESCE(task_section.Complete_Records_Need, task_global.Complete_Records_Need) AS Complete_Records_Need, COALESCE(task_section.P_Remove_Need, task_global.P_Remove_Need) AS P_Remove_Need, COALESCE(task_section.Set_Time_handle, task_global.Set_Time_handle) AS Set_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Start_Time_handle, task_global.Start_Time_handle) AS Start_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Finish_Time_handle, task_global.Finish_Time_handle) AS Finish_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Complete_Time_handle, task_global.Complete_Time_handle) AS Complete_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Complete_Records_Time_handle, task_global.Complete_Records_Time_handle) AS Complete_Records_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.P_Remove_Time_handle, task_global.P_Remove_Time_handle) AS P_Remove_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Account_Submit_Time_handle, task_global.Account_Submit_Time_handle) AS Account_Submit_Time_handle, COALESCE(task_section.Account_Reply_Time_handle, task_global.Account_Reply_Time_handle) AS Account_Reply_Time_handle FROM gantt_plan gp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P_Id, P_Name, P_Category, P_Competent_Department, P_Department, P_Inv_Total, State, deleted, P_Status, CASE WHEN P_Project_Form_Type = '01' THEN P_Approve_Budget_Date WHEN P_Project_Form_Type = '02' THEN P_Record_Date WHEN P_Project_Form_Type = '03' THEN P_Apply_Date END AS Set_Time FROM pre_project ) AS pp ON gp.P_Id = pp.P_Id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, plan_id, Gs_Section FROM gant_section UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS id, plan_id, '全标段' AS Gs_Section FROM gantt_plan WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gant_section WHERE gant_section.plan_id = gantt_plan.Plan_Id) ) AS gs ON gp.Plan_Id = gs.plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT Plan_Id, gs_id, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Set_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Start_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Finish_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Complete_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Complete_Records_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN COALESCE(Must_Handle, 0) END) AS Complete_Records_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS P_Remove_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN COALESCE(Must_Handle, 0) END) AS P_Remove_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Account_Submit_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Account_Reply_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Set_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Start_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Finish_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Complete_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Complete_Records_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Must_Handle END) AS P_Remove_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Account_Submit_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Account_Reply_Time_handle FROM gantt_tasks WHERE gs_id IS NOT NULL and gs_id != '' GROUP BY Plan_Id, gs_id ) AS task_section ON gp.Plan_Id = task_section.Plan_Id AND gs.id = task_section.gs_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT Plan_Id, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Set_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Start_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Finish_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Complete_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Complete_Records_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN COALESCE(Must_Handle, 0) END) AS Complete_Records_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS P_Remove_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN COALESCE(Must_Handle, 0) END) AS P_Remove_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Account_Submit_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN COALESCE(Task_Finish_Time, Task_End_Date) END) AS Account_Reply_Time, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Set_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Start_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Finish_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Complete_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Complete_Records_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Must_Handle END) AS P_Remove_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Account_Submit_Time_handle, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Account_Reply_Time_handle FROM gantt_tasks WHERE gs_id IS NULL or gs_id ='' GROUP BY Plan_Id ) AS task_global ON gp.Plan_Id = task_global.Plan_Id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT Plan_Id, NULLIF(gs_id, '') AS gs_id, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Set_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Set_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Start_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Start_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Finish_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Finish_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Complete_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Complete_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Complete_Records_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Complete_Records_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS P_Remove_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS P_Remove_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Account_Submit_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Account_Submit_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Account_Reply_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Account_Reply_Time_Finish FROM gantt_tasks GROUP BY Plan_Id, NULLIF(gs_id, '') )AS sp ON gp.Plan_Id = sp.Plan_Id WHERE gp.Plan_State = 7 and pp.State = 7 and pp.deleted = false and pp.P_Status = '1'
select * from pre_project where State = 7 and deleted = false and P_Status = '1'

select gp.P_Id, gp.Plan_Id, times.gs_id, times.Set_Time_Finish, times.Start_Time_Finish, times.Finish_Time_Finish, times.Complete_Time_Finish, times.Complete_Records_Time_Finish, times.P_Remove_Time_Finish, times.Account_Submit_Time_Finish, times.AccountReplyTime_Finish,
times.Complete_Records_Need, times.P_Remove_Need,
times.Set_Time_Schedule, times.Start_Time_Schedule, times.Finish_Time_Schedule, times.Complete_Time_Schedule, times.Complete_Records_Time_Schedule, times.P_Remove_Time_Schedule, times.Account_Submit_Time_Schedule, times.AccountReplyTime_Schedule
from gantt_plan gp LEFT JOIN (SELECT Plan_Id, NULLIF(gs_id, '') AS gs_id, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Set_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Start_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Finish_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Complete_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Complete_Records_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Must_Handle END) AS Complete_Records_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS P_Remove_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Must_Handle END) AS P_Remove_Need, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS Account_Submit_Time_Finish, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Task_Finish_Time END) AS AccountReplyTime_Finish,
MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目立项' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Set_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '开工' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Start_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '项目完工' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Finish_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工验收' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Complete_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '竣工备案' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Complete_Records_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '工程移交' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS P_Remove_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算上报' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS Account_Submit_Time_Schedule, MAX(CASE Task_Text WHEN '决算批复' THEN Task_End_Date END) AS AccountReplyTime_Schedule FROM gantt_tasks GROUP BY Plan_Id, NULLIF(gs_id, '')) AS times ON gp.Plan_Id = times.Plan_Id
